scripts.build: pnpm build:agent && pnpm --filter @noemori/vault-node build && pnpm --filter @noemori/desktop build
scripts.check: pnpm check:agent && pnpm --filter @noemori/desktop check && pnpm check:export-tests
scripts.test:resources: pnpm test:resources:contracts && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @noemori/desktop exec vitest run --config ../../../../test/vitest.resources.config.ts
scripts.test:resources:soak: pnpm build && NOEMORI_RESOURCE_CYCLES=2000 pnpm --filter @noemori/desktop exec vitest run --config ../../../../test/vitest.resources.config.ts
scripts.test:resources:contracts: pnpm --filter @noemori/desktop exec vitest run --config ../../../../test/vitest.resource-contracts.config.ts && cd modules/notes && cargo test --workspace --locked --lib resource_ && cargo test -p noemori-vault --locked --test vault_integration_resources --test vault_integration_watch
scripts.test:agent: cargo build --manifest-path modules/agent/Cargo.toml --locked --example web && pnpm --filter @noemori/agent-web-runtime test && pnpm --filter @noemori/agent-web-runtime test:e2e && cargo test --manifest-path modules/agent/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.lint:agent: cargo fmt --manifest-path modules/agent/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path modules/agent/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.test:rust: pnpm test:agent && cd modules/notes && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.lint:rust: pnpm lint:agent && cd modules/notes && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
